environment: Managed local Sites preview, cloud Chrome
checks: Catalogue loads all 377 indexed JSON protocols and searches NCCP 00849.
Clinic workflow opens the 00849 assessment with five alternative backbones and surgery/follow-up.
Selecting gemcitabine/carboplatin without a day leaves supportive risk phase-dependent and no Day 1 script selected.
Selecting Day 8 changes the clinical display to low emetogenic risk; the partial assessment remains explicitly incomplete.
00849 guide selector retains the requested asset and exposes exactly five backbone-specific guide.pdf links.
Gemcitabine/carboplatin supportive-care selector shows only the selected Day 8 plan with gemcitabine alone and its own PDF link.
observed_fix: Pass treatment_day to the supportive risk resolver and require source-declared backbone/day mapping rather than defaulting to Day 1.
limits: Representative browser interactions; full protocol boundaries, source metadata, PDF links and other suites are covered by executable regression checks. Browser testing is not clinical validation.
